notes: Hand-crafted baseline for the node-ipc supply-chain attack simulation. Represents a hypothetical 'pre-compromise' baseline that a team running node-ipc@9.2.1 might have committed before the May 2026 attack on later versions. Pure-Node IPC library, same install shape as other pure-JS packages (npm/node execve + loopback + registry over TLS). This baseline doesn't reflect a real captured fingerprint — node-ipc@9.2.1 was never run in our environment — but the allowlists match what a clean npm install would produce.
